subject: represent cluster node flags with bitwise shift value (#642)
reason: The change only rewrites the CLUSTER_NODE_* flag macros in cluster_legacy.h from decimal literals (1, 2, 4, ..., 1024) to the mathematically identical bit-shift expressions ((1 << 0) ... (1 << 10)). Every macro evaluates to the same value as before, no code using the flags is touched, and the compiled behavior is unchanged. This is a pure readability refactor with no behavior change, so there is nothing for a scenario to exercise.
